about.hero_subtitle: Who we are, what we believe, and why we exist.
about.story_body1: Haluan was founded by Palestinians and Malaysian supporters who needed an organized, credible voice for Palestine in Malaysia.
about.story_body2: What started as informal gatherings has grown into a structured organization running campaigns, hosting events, and channelling aid directly to Palestinians in need.
about.mission_body: To promote and strengthen the Palestinian community in Malaysia, develop meaningful and lasting relations with the Malaysian community, and uphold national, social, and humanitarian rights while building fruitful cooperation between both communities.
about.vision_body: To be a leading Palestinian body in the national, cultural, and educational sectors — serving the Palestinian community in Malaysia and achieving the aspirational goals of liberating Palestine and securing the right of return for Palestinian refugees to their homelands.
about.value_justice_desc: We believe every human life has equal worth. Justice for Palestine is justice for all.
about.value_solidarity_desc: We stand together — Malaysian, Palestinian, and all who believe in a just world.
about.value_transparency_desc: Every donation is accounted for. We publish reports so you know where your help goes.
about.value_action_desc: We don't just raise awareness — we mobilize, fundraise, and act when it matters most.
about.obj1_desc: Spread the culture of unity and cooperation among Palestinians in Malaysia.
about.obj2_desc: Invest in the skills and professional development of young Palestinian community members.
about.obj3_desc: Build the spirit of Palestinian–Malaysian solidarity and community cohesion.
about.obj4_desc: Offer educational, health, and legal guidance and support to community members.
about.obj5_desc: Develop the Palestinian community's participation in national, social, and humanitarian efforts within Malaysia.
about.obj6_desc: Achieve shared values of brotherhood and cooperation with the Malaysian and Arab communities.
about.coverage_desc: Haluan has an active presence in major cities across Malaysia, bringing the community together nationwide.
about.partners_desc: We work alongside trusted organisations to maximise our impact for the Palestinian community.
about.cta_desc: Whether you donate, volunteer, or simply spread the word — every action strengthens our community and amplifies the Palestinian cause.
about.trustee1_bio: Born in Kedah, Malaysia. Works in the Malaysian telecommunications sector and is a director of a private school — a long-standing humanitarian worker and active supporter of the Palestinian cause.
about.trustee2_bio: Born in Penang, Malaysia. Executive Director of Al-Iqan Educational Centre and Treasurer of an NGO in Penang — extensively active in civil and relief institutions for many years.

hero.title: Brand & UI Style Guide
hero.subtitle: The visual language behind the {{client}} platform: our colours, typography and the interface components used across the website and dashboards. Every example on this page is the live component used in the product.

brand.title: Brand Identity & Colors
brand.intro: {{client}}'s identity is built on a primary brand colour and a dark ink colour taken from the logo. Navy and neutral greys support them in the interface. Every swatch shows its HEX value and design token.
brand.primary_desc: The signature colour of the {{client}} logo. Use it for brand moments, highlights, badges and key accents.
brand.pair_navy: Navy text on the brand colour
brand.pair_white: White text on the brand colour
brand.palette_intro: Tints and shades of the brand colour from 50 to 900.
brand.secondary_intro: Supporting colours that work with the brand colour. Green is used only for success states and is not part of the {{client}} brand.
brand.role_navy: Headings, statistics and dark interface surfaces.
brand.surface_intro: The layers that pages and components sit on, from the page canvas to brand-tinted and dark surfaces.
brand.text_intro: Text colours by importance. The badge shows the WCAG contrast ratio against the background the colour is used on.
brand.text_disabled_note: No dedicated colour. Disabled elements are shown at 50% opacity.
brand.semantic_intro: Functional status colours, used only to show the outcome of an action and never as brand colours. These are the exact tokens used by alerts and notifications.
brand.border_intro: Border colours for cards, inputs and dividers, plus focus and error states.
brand.proposals_intro: Remaining gaps found while aligning the platform with the {{client}} brand. These are suggestions for approval only.

proposals.muted_text: Muted text (slate-400) is 2.6:1 on white, below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum. Proposal: use slate-500 for readable text and keep slate-400 for placeholders and icons.
proposals.disabled_text: There is no dedicated disabled text colour. Proposal: add slate-300 as the disabled text colour.
proposals.red_50: red-50 is defined as a translucent value (#EE5D501A), unlike every other 50 shade. Proposal: a solid #FEF2F2.

brand.pair_black: Ink text on the brand colour (logo)
brand.role_black: The logo's dark ink. Use it for the footer, dark heroes, brand moments on dark backgrounds and strong text on the brand colour.
brand.role_navy_deep: Darkest navy, for hero backgrounds and deep surfaces.
brand.role_slate: Primary text colour and neutral interface greys.
brand.logo_intro: The approved versions of the logo. Use the supplied files as they are: don't recolour, stretch or redraw them.
brand.logo_icon: Icon — app, favicon and small spaces
brand.logo_fallback: Not supplied yet — showing the primary logo.
brand.logo_missing: Not supplied yet — showing a placeholder.

typography.intro: Clean, highly legible typefaces for both English and Arabic, with a consistent scale across the platform.
typography.font_dm: Primary typeface for English. Used for all interface text and body copy.
typography.font_cairo: Arabic typeface. Applied automatically when the site is viewed in Arabic.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.intro: The spacing, corner radius, elevation and screen sizes that keep every page consistent.

buttons.button_desc: The base button, with four variants for different levels of emphasis.
buttons.flow_desc: Preset buttons for multi-step forms and dialogs.
buttons.icon_desc: Compact buttons for toolbars and table rows.
buttons.dropdown_desc: Groups secondary actions under one trigger. Click to open.

forms.ph_message: Tell us how we can help…

forms.select_desc: Dropdowns for choosing one or many options, with optional search.

forms.search_desc: A search field for filtering lists and tables.

content.title: Content
content.intro: Building blocks for showing people, statuses and short hints, and for keeping the page calm while it loads.
content.avatar_desc: Photos or initials in four sizes, with an optional status dot. Groups overlap and count the rest.
content.badge_desc: Short labels for statuses and categories. Use the dot for live states and the solid style sparingly.
content.tooltip_desc: A short hint on hover or keyboard focus — for icon buttons and terms that need explaining.
content.skeleton_desc: Placeholders in the shape of the content, shown while it loads.
content.calendar_desc: A month view for picking or highlighting dates; it follows the brand colours.

handoff.intro: Everything a developer needs to build {{client}}'s product with these components: a Tailwind config and base CSS generated from this guide. Add both files to the project and every class on this page works as shown.
handoff.tokens_intro: Use these class names for brand colours and type; the rest of the palette (slate, navy, green, red…) is included too.
handoff.config_desc: Brand colours, accents, fonts and the shared theme for the project's Tailwind setup.
handoff.css_desc: Font imports and base typography, including Arabic.

brand.intro: Haluan's identity is built on two colours taken from the logo: a warm gold and black. Navy and neutral greys support them in the interface. Every swatch shows its HEX value and design token.
brand.primary_desc: The signature gold of the Haluan logo. Use it for brand moments, highlights, badges and key accents. Always pair it with black or navy text.
brand.palette_intro: Tints and shades of the brand gold from 50 to 900. All ten shades are already defined, so no new shades are needed.
brand.secondary_intro: Supporting colours that work with the gold. Green is used only for success states and is not part of the Haluan brand.
brand.surface_intro: The layers that pages and components sit on, from the page canvas to gold-tinted and dark surfaces.
brand.role_black: The logo's black. Use it for the footer, dark heroes, gold-on-black brand moments and strong text on gold.
